name: @oplyr/desktop
description: Oplyr — a desktop cockpit for AI coding agents. Direct them by voice or text and review every change, on your Mac.
author: Oplyr <hello@oplyr.com>

scripts.dist:publish: npm run build && electron-builder --mac zip --publish always
scripts.dist:mac: npm run rebuild:native && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never && electron-builder --mac zip --prepackaged release/mac-arm64/Oplyr.app --publish never && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
